title: EQUATOR: A Deterministic Framework for Evaluating LLM Reasoning with Open-Ended Questions. # v1.0.0-beta

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the discrepancy in model performance scores between traditional benchmarks and a strict deterministic framework (EQUATOR) to demonstrate how traditional methods overestimate capabilities by rewarding fluent, logically coherent, but factually incorrect responses.

Comparing scores assigned by human evaluators or standard LLM-as-a-judge models (which are prone to favoring persuasive arguments or granting partial credit) against a deterministic scoring system that rigidly assesses factual correctness using a vector database of correct answers.
